display_long_description:
Cosmic Rubik's Cube is a cinematic VR sci-fi short series by LightSource Studio, spannning 20 episodes. It explores a real-world paradox of parallel worlds, choice, and belonging. Blending science fiction, mystery, and deep emotion, the series asks how choices shape a life—and how love and belonging can reach across universes. Follow Liang Xin as he traverses strange worlds on a visceral journey of self-redemption and family bonds.

What You’ll Experience
Film-grade visuals: Ultra-high-resolution 8K VR180 stereoscopic depth and detail.
Episodic structure: A live-action sci-fi mystery short series with tight clues and twists each episode.
Immersive viewing: Non-interactive, cinema-style experience; headphones or a quiet environment recommended for comfort and clarity.
Multi-language: Subtitles available; Chinese is the native dub, with other language dubs in production.

Content Roadmap
Season 1: 10 episodes (Coming Soon)
Season 2: 10 episodes (in post-production; rolling releases planned)

Who It's For
Fans of sci-fi, mystery, and multiverse narratives seeking a premium cinematic VR experience—completely hands-free.

LightSource Studio — we use the language of cinema and real-time technology to build worlds you can step into.

Note: On-device resolution and smoothness depend on your headset and settings. Contains brief intense moments and rapid cuts; take breaks if you are prone to motion discomfort.
